Serenissima

A thousand years of republic in a single profile

Serenissima was not merely the name of a state: it was a promise of composure. The frame translates it into a restrained cat-eye profile that lifts slightly at the corners and stops just short of becoming a statement. Short proportions, a light temple, an authority that needs no explanation.
